related.title: 精密滾動軸承製造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平方根關係及條件限制都寫明，硬度測量不是材料擴散量的直接替代。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: State square-root scaling and its conditions, without treating hardness as a direct diffusion measurement.
related.difference: 正確把百萬轉換成小時，說明 L10 是群體統計額定值而非個別保證。
related.differenceEn: Convert million revolutions to hours and explain L10 as a population rating rather than an individual guarantee.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在相同溫度、邊界濃度及擴散條件的簡化模型，特徵深度 x∝√t；比例律不能外推跨材料或溫度。 純教學基準時間4 h 對應特徵深度0.6 mm，評估同條件9 h；不是熱處理配方。 x2=x1√(t2/t1)=0.6√(9/4)=0.9 mm；深度加50%需要時間乘2.25。
球軸承基本額定壽命 L10=(C/P)^3 百萬轉，L10h=10^6L10/(60n)；它對應模型條件下90%可靠度的滾動疲勞額定值，其他失效機制未含。 教學 C=30 kN、等效動載荷P=10 kN、轉速n=1000 rpm；球軸承而非滾子。 L10=27百萬轉；L10h=27×10^6/(60×1000)=450 h。未計污染、潤滑及安裝因素。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Under unchanged temperature, boundary concentration and diffusion conditions, characteristic depth x∝√t; do not extrapolate across materials or temperature. Teaching reference 4 h corresponds to characteristic depth 0.6 mm; assess 9 h at unchanged conditions, not an operating recipe. x 2=0.6√(9/4)=0.9 mm;50% more depth requires 2.25 times the duration.

For ball bearings L10=(C/P)^3 million revolutions and L10 h=10^6 L10/(60 n). This basic rolling-fatigue rating corresponds to 90% reliability under model assumptions; other failure modes are excluded. Teaching C 30 kN, equivalent dynamic load P 10 kN, speed 1000 rpm; ball bearings, not rollers. L10=27 million revolutions; L10 h=450 h, without contamination, lubrication or installation adjustments.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機器人手眼校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平方根關係及條件限制都寫明，硬度測量不是材料擴散量的直接替代。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: State square-root scaling and its conditions, without treating hardness as a direct diffusion measurement.
related.difference: 用小型坐標例子驗證變換乘法順序，並以保留姿態評估校準。
related.differenceEn: Verify transform order with a small coordinate example and assess calibration on held-out poses.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在相同溫度、邊界濃度及擴散條件的簡化模型，特徵深度 x∝√t；比例律不能外推跨材料或溫度。 純教學基準時間4 h 對應特徵深度0.6 mm，評估同條件9 h；不是熱處理配方。 x2=x1√(t2/t1)=0.6√(9/4)=0.9 mm；深度加50%需要時間乘2.25。
點變換pB=RBC pC+tBC；平移向量必須表達在B框架。旋轉誤差造成的橫向偏移約Lδθ。 合成相機點(10,0,0) mm，繞z旋轉90°，B框架平移(30,0,0) mm；另取工作距離500 mm。 先旋轉得(0,10,0)，再平移得(30,10,0) mm；1°角誤差在500 mm的橫偏=500sin1°=8.7262 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Under unchanged temperature, boundary concentration and diffusion conditions, characteristic depth x∝√t; do not extrapolate across materials or temperature. Teaching reference 4 h corresponds to characteristic depth 0.6 mm; assess 9 h at unchanged conditions, not an operating recipe. x 2=0.6√(9/4)=0.9 mm;50% more depth requires 2.25 times the duration.

Point transform pB=RBC pC+tBC requires translation in frame B; small angular error produces transverse offset approximately L δθ. Synthetic camera point(10,0,0) mm,90° z rotation and B-frame translation(30,0,0) mm; working distance 500 mm. Rotate to(0,10,0), then translate to(30,10,0) mm;1° angular error at 500 mm gives 500 sin 1°=8.7262 mm transverse offset.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
